images.description: CMDB Workspace Home view. Important actions shows three Health cards: De-duplication tasks (9 tasks, De-duplication dashboard button), Duplicate CIs (325 CIs, View CIs button) and Stale CIs (123 CIs, View CIs button). The CMDB Health card on the right shows Completeness 100%, Correctness 84% and Compliance 7%. Also shows Intelligent search, My work (Open tasks 0, Overdue tasks 0) and Total CIs 2.8K.

images.source_document: Live capture, ServiceNow developer instance (Brazil release), CMDB Workspace

images.description: CMDB Workspace Management view. Tiles for Rejected CIs (0), Excluded CIs (0) and Draft policies (0). CI correctness section with Timeframe Last 24 hours: Duplicate CI count 325, Orphan CI count No score, Stale CI count 123. Management tools list on the right: Manage (CI Class Manager, Data Manager, CMDB Groups, Dynamic CI Groups, De-duplication Template Library, De-duplication Dashboard), Optimize (CMDB Health, CMDB Data Foundations Dashboard, CSDM Data Foundations Dashboard, De-Duplication Tasks, CMDB Remediation Rules), Visualize (Dependency View, Query Builder, Unified Map).

images.description: CMDB Health Dashboard (Management > CMDB Health) for all Configuration Item CIs. Class view selector and Configuration Item class selector at the top, CMDB Health settings button top right, Use legacy calculation methods toggle. Overall score 64%. KPI tiles with donut charts: Completeness 100% (2.79K CIs evaluated), Correctness 84% (2.79K CIs evaluated), Compliance 7% (45 CIs evaluated). Each tile shows the evaluation date. Tabs below for Missing required attributes and Missing recommended attributes.
images.alt: CMDB Health Dashboard showing Completeness, Correctness and Compliance KPI tiles with overall score
